Name: Yet Another Crystal Path Recolor (CP)
Author: UlyanaLeyana
Description:
The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1717]Yet Another Crystal Path Recolor[/url] mod changed the XNB files, but we don't need replace XNB files anymore because since 2017 we got a lot of changes, so I made a CP version of the mod.
Also you can choose a recolor for winter crystal paths.

[color=#cc0000][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size][/color][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿  version 1.20.0 or higher.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI once to generate config.json
[*]Edit config.json to your liking.

[/list]
[b]Config options[/b]:
"Crystal Path Recolor" : "colorful" "colorfulsubdued" "enhancedvanilla" ("Default": "colorful")
"Crystal Path Recolor Winter" : "colorful" "colorfulsubdued" "enhancedvanilla" "none" ("Default": "none")

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fOT5GMv.png[/img]

Enjoy!






[b]Original mod[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1717]Yet Another Crystal Path Recolor[/url]﻿
